headline: Open Code Review Builds a Deeper Review Loop
lede: Open Code Review treats code review as a layered system: deterministic pipelines establish coverage and scope, while an LLM agent investigates context across files. Its CLI turns that architecture into resumable, model-agnostic workflows with line-level findings and configurable rules.

headline: Modern Web Guidance Rebuilds the Agent’s Browser Sense
lede: This curated guidance system gives coding agents a sharper visual and semantic vocabulary for today’s web. Container queries, view transitions, accessibility patterns, and native browser APIs replace stale conventions with practical platform-first instructions.

headline: Codex Security Turns Findings Into Verified Fixes
lede: Codex Security moves vulnerability analysis beyond the alert queue. It scans repositories and diffs, investigates suspected flaws, proposes patches, verifies remediation, and routes evidence into the security workflows teams already use.

headline: Daily Stock Analysis Connects Markets to Models
lede: This market-analysis platform pulls prices, fundamentals, news, sentiment, and technical signals into a continuous research stream. Dashboards, agent conversations, scheduled reports, and backtesting give investors a connected view across Asian, U.S., and global markets.

headline: Sure Reclaims the Personal Finance Stack
lede: Sure gives households a self-hosted alternative for tracking money, investments, and wealth without handing their financial history to a closed platform. Built from the remains of Maybe Finance, it pairs local control with web, desktop, mobile, API, and optional AI access.

headline: Plannotator Gives Coding Agents a Review Desk
lede: Plannotator puts a practical terminal-and-browser layer between human intent and agent execution. Plans, code changes, documents, and questions become annotatable work items that can flow back through hooks, plugins, MCP, and version-control integrations.

headline: Uptime Kuma Keeps Every Service Accountable
lede: Uptime Kuma turns self-hosted monitoring into a dependable operations surface for endpoints, containers, networks, and internal services. Broad probe support, status pages, certificate visibility, and durable alert integrations make it equally useful in a homelab or production environment.

headline: Uptime Kuma Clears 93,000 Stars
lede: The self-hosted monitor has become a landmark open-source utility, pairing a polished interface with checks for nearly every common service shape. Its star count reflects the durable appeal of owning the watchtower as well as the workload.

headline: Claude Trading Skills Catalogs a Disciplined Practice
lede: This open toolkit assembles market research into reusable skills, ordered workflows, and reviewable artifacts. From regime analysis and position sizing to journaling and post-trade reflection, it treats AI as a structured research assistant rather than an autonomous trader.

headline: Tailcat Opens a Smaller Door Through WireGuard
lede: Tailcat strips ad hoc connectivity down to a userspace command and an encrypted path. Built on Magicsock and WireGuard, it establishes short-lived peer connections, traverses NAT when possible, relays when necessary, and avoids accounts, elevated privileges, and routing changes.
